🇲🇽🩺 <u>ISSSTE TARGETS 10% MORE SURGERIES IN 2026, WITH 60+ OPERATING ROOMS ALREADY REBUILT</u>

Mexico's ISSSTE is taking on the surgical backlog. Director Martí Batres says the institute will perform 10% more surgeries in 2026 than last year — backed by surgical drives that have already delivered over 1,700 high-specialty procedures (hips, knees, cataracts, prostate) and a national program that has rehabilitated more than 60 of 80 planned operating rooms. "Increasing the number of surgeries is one of our main objectives for caring for our members' health." The neoliberal model left patients waiting for years; the 4T is clearing the backlog room by room.

🇲🇽⚖️ <u>498 KILOS OF ILLEGAL MERCURY: QUERÉTARO SUSPECT BOUND FOR TRIAL</u>

Mexico is prosecuting the supply chain behind illegal mining. A federal judge in Querétaro bound a suspect for trial after Profepa and the FGR seized 497.8 kilograms of mercury — 18 metal containers hauled in pickup trucks with none of the required safety measures. The charge: environmental crimes under Article 414 of the Federal Penal Code. Mercury is the silent poison of the illegal gold trade — and the 4T is going after the traffickers, not just the mines.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>WASHINGTON'S IDEOLOGICAL VISA BAN: "EXTREME-LEFT" FOREIGNERS LOCKED OUT</u>

Mexico refused to attend Marco Rubio's summit against the Latin American left — hours later, the US State Department unveiled visa restrictions on foreigners it links to "extreme-left terrorist groups." The policy runs on National Security Presidential Memorandum-7 and Section 212(a)(3)(C) of the Immigration and Nationality Act: anyone who "supported" or "incited" what Washington brands political violence can be barred. First they criminalized migration. Now they criminalize ideology.

🇲🇽💵 <u>MEXICO'S TAX ON SODA, TOBACCO AND JUNK FOOD HITS RECORD 132 BILLION PESOS</u>

Mexico collected a record 132 billion pesos in the first half of 2026 from the IEPS tax on soda, tobacco, beer and junk food — the highest January-June take since records began in 1990, SHCP data shows. Taxes on sugary drinks alone jumped 65.8% year-on-year, to 32.7 billion pesos. The 4T taxes what makes people sick and funds the state with it. The stakes, per the FAO: adult obesity in Mexico climbed from 29.7% to 37.4% between 2012 and 2024.

🇲🇽🏥 <u>OAXACA'S "TOWN THAT HEALS": SHEINBAUM LAYS FIRST STONE OF NEW IMSS HOSPITAL</u>

Claudia Sheinbaum closed her Oaxaca tour laying the first stone of a new IMSS general hospital in San Lorenzo Cacaotepec — part of a Health City already named Ñuu Tata, "the town that heals," in Mixtec. The hospital will serve nearly one million people with 530 beds, 53 consulting rooms and 57 specialties; a second, ISSSTE hospital on the same site is already 62% built. Her math is blunt: 36 neoliberal years added just 4,000 hospital beds nationwide — this sexenio alone will add 9,000. "It is called justice, social justice for Oaxaca."

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>PEMEX OIL WORKERS EXTEND WAGE TALKS 30 DAYS, KEEP OPERATIONS RUNNING</u>

No strike at Pemex — for now. The STPRM granted a 30-day extension to its pre-strike period in the 2026 wage review after the state oil company failed to table a formal offer, union chief Ricardo Aldana Prieto confirmed before the Federal Labor Tribunal. The decision, backed by worker assemblies in all 36 sections, aims to "maintain the company's operational normality for the benefit of the country's stability." Last year's deal closed above inflation; the oil workers expect no less this time.
banner: PEMEX UNION EXTENDS WAGE TALKS 30 DAYS

🇲🇽🗳️ <u>MORENA HOLDS 217 ASSEMBLIES TO DEFEND SOVEREIGNTY AND THE 4T</u>

While Washington recycles five-month-old hit pieces, Morena went back to territory: 217 assemblies across Mexico this weekend to strengthen the defense of national sovereignty and the advances of the Fourth Transformation. The message from the governing party's base is simple — the transformation isn't negotiated in editorials, it's organized in every municipality.

💰🇲🇽 <u>16.5 MILLION MEXICANS RECEIVE THEIR WELFARE PENSIONS</u>

The July–August payment run is on: 13.79 million seniors and 2.78 million women — 16,571,522 people in all — are receiving their Bienestar deposits, an investment of 378.8 billion pesos, Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez announced. The senior pension now pays 6,400 pesos bimonthly through Banco del Bienestar cards. The largest direct-transfer operation in Mexico's history, delivered on schedule.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO RECOVERS 3,716 LOOTED ARTIFACTS UNDER SHEINBAUM</u>

"Mi patrimonio no se vende" is delivering: in a year and nine months, Sheinbaum's government has repatriated 3,716 cultural goods — ten times Peña Nieto's entire six-year term and 68% more than Calderón's, per INAH. The 4T total is now 17,878 pieces. The US returned 3,369, Italy 174, Canada 133. And many don't go to a warehouse — they go back to the communities that created them.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>12 YEARS AFTER GRUPO MÉXICO POISONED THE RÍO SONORA, STILL NO JUSTICE</u>

On August 6, 2014, Germán Larrea's Buenavista del Cobre mine dumped 40 million liters of acidified copper sulfate into the Bacanuchi and Sonora rivers — the worst environmental disaster in Mexico's history. Twelve years on, eight municipalities still lack safe water, medical care and real remediation, while officials negotiate with the company behind closed doors. From the IV Festival for the Life and Water of the Río Sonora: "Shame must switch sides and fall on those who play politics with our pain."
